scope: Three rotating serial fresh-process samples per backend and workload; MyPy has an empty cache and uses --no-incremental.
Both plugin-enabled checkers accept exact ORM types and reject both ORM and ordinary Python assignment errors.
Bare official ty has the expected ORM errors and is not equivalent Django checking.
Measurements are specific to these generated projects and hosts; they do not bound arbitrary applications or compare persistent MyPy daemon performance.
The macOS stress result is near parity with MyPy; its one-percent margin is not evidence of a meaningful speed advantage.

negative_source_validation.scope: All five macOS candidate workloads and the published baseline: one diagnostic at the ORM assignment and one at the ordinary Python assignment. Original measurement-runner hash is retained separately.
